---
# The template's body. Its title, abstract, and keywords live in
# _quarto.yml (base); its authorship, acknowledgments, funding, and
# correspondence live in _quarto-pretty.yml (display); the blind copy reads
# neither and renders with --profile blind (see _quarto-blind.yml and
# submit.sh). A paper created by `quarto use template` renames this file
# and keeps pointing at those three files.
---

The masthead carries the working-paper identity; the body demonstrates the
type it governs — *italic*, **bold** (SemiBold), `code` set in IBM Plex Mono
and colored Blueprint, a variable $\lambda_k = \rho \sum_j w_{kj} x_j$ in IBM
Plex Math, and a footnote[^1].

| Surface | Set in |
|---|---|
| Title | Libre Franklin ExtraBold |
| Series line | IBM Plex Mono, letter-spaced |
| Body | IBM Plex Serif |
| Mathematics | IBM Plex Math |

[^1]: Footnotes set small in IBM Plex Serif.
